definition: אֲדֹנִיצֶֿ֫דֶק proper name, masculine Canaanite king of Jerusalem Josh 10:1 ; Josh 10:3 ( Lord of righteousness; my lord is righteous , or my Lord is ‚idiq — divine name — compare מַלְכִּי צֶדֶק , אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ , Phoenician אדנבעל etc.)

BDB129 [H139]

BDB128 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB130

אֲדֹנִיצֶֿ֫דֶק proper name, masculine Canaanite king of Jerusalem Josh 10:1; Josh 10:3 (Lord of righteousness; my lord is righteous, or my Lord is ‚idiq — divine name — compare מַלְכִּי צֶדֶק, אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ, Phoenician אדנבעל etc.)
